verdict.rationale: Policy-as-code is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence shows no built-in policy engine or pre-apply policy gate. Saved plan files (`-out`) and `tofu test` assertions are building blocks or adjacent testing features, not enforcement that blocks non-compliant changes before apply. `tofu test` in particular creates real infrastructure and then destroys it, so it is not a gate on apply.
